title: Quantum Walk Search
description: Search marked vertices with continuous-time quantum-walk Hamiltonian evolution.

params.name: marked
params.info: 请输入逗号分隔的顶点编号。

params.name: graph_json
params.help: Optional adjacency matrix or edge-list JSON; overrides graph_type.
params.info: 可留空，或输入邻接矩阵/边列表JSON。

params.name: gamma
params.info: 留空自动选择，或输入正数。

params.name: evolution_time
params.help: Empty performs a small exact spectral scan.
params.info: 留空自动扫描，或输入非负数。

params.name: method
params.help: A method supported by UnitaryLab hamiltonian_simulation.

params.name: target_error
params.help: Positive simulator parameter; not a guaranteed achieved error bound.

params.name: backend
params.help: Forwarded to Hamiltonian simulation and circuit execution; default numpy.
params.info: 可选 numpy、torch 或 cpp，取决于已安装模拟器。

params.name: device
params.help: cpu by default; gpu requires a supported backend and device.
params.info: numpy 仅支持 cpu；gpu 取决于后端和硬件。

params.name: dtype
params.help: Circuit execution precision; spectral reference retains original NumPy precision.
params.info: 可选 complex64 或 complex128；默认 complex128。
